people.name: Ararat
people.line: A mountain range where Noah's ark rested after the flood.

translations.web: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.
translations.bsb: On the seventeenth day of the seventh month, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
translations.kjv: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
translations.asv: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
